docs.title: Personal Website
docs.text: Bastian Politycki is a researcher in the field of Digital Humanities, holding positions at two universities. Since October 2021, he has been an Associate Researcher at the University of St. Gallen within the Swiss Law Sources (SLS) project. Additionally, as of November 2025, he serves as a Research Associate at the Chair for Digital Humanities at the University of Wuppertal. He studied Editing and Documentology at the University of Wuppertal, where he successfully defended his PhD in November 2025. His dissertation is dedicated to the critical (audio) edition of Paul Wuehr's radio play So eine Freiheit.
